rule: Bat buoc dung BoundedMemoryCache voi ngan sach RAM va LRU eviction cho toan bo tai nguyen tinh; CMD -74 phai dung bounded executor kem single-flight deduplication per session

symptom: Netty Decoder tran 200KB de bi flood; Controller doc payload thieu byte gay EOFException ngam va desync stream; Message.getData() tra ve mang rong khi tao tu byte array
root_cause: Thieu co che ensure(n) truoc khi doc stream; khong phan loai han muc goi tin theo opcode; constructor Message bo quen gan cachedData
rule: Ha tran standard packet xuong 64KB, chi noi 200KB cho opcode lon (-74). Controller bat buoc validate byte bang ensure(n) va disconnect khi underflow. Constructor Message phai gan cachedData = data.

rule: 1. Moi Zone so huu mot SerialExecutor lock-free (WIP trampoline loop) chay tren shared Virtual Thread pool de thuc thi tuan tu Single-Writer; 2. Dispatch non-blocking update() voi co AtomicBoolean isUpdating; 3. Dung co volatile boolean isChangingMap chan packet chen giua trong luc chuyen map; 4. Tuan tu hoa pickItem, addItem, removeItemMap qua zone.execute.

symptom: CI GitHub Actions fail o TestZoneSerialExecutor voi loi Executor drain het sach va WIP tro ve 0 va NPE zone.map.mapId

symptom: Vao game va xoa du lieu tai lai bi xoay tron shuriken mai khong vao duoc
root_cause: Netty NroPacketDecoder yeu cau >= 3 bytes truoc khi decode khien goi Handshake 1-byte (-27) bi treo vo han, GameCanvas crash IndexOutOfRangeException tren hasConnected[2], thieu guard tranh show2() tai lap khi dang download
rule: Netty decoder phai xu ly goi tin Handshake 1-byte (-27) truoc khi check min 3 bytes. Client phai kiem tra bien mang hasConnected theo length va tu dong thoat isGetData neu ngat ket noi.

symptom: Vao game va xoa du lieu tai lai bi xoay tron mai khong the vao duoc game
root_cause: Thu muc res/x1 thieu Big0..5 lam crash SmallImage null imgbig; SplashScr switchToMe ghi de thol bao len download state; ServerListScreen cancel va show2 gay vong lap vo tan va trung lap request CMD -74; thieu fallback x2 cho zoomLevel
rule: Bat buoc dam bao dong bo du lieu dia giua cac thu muc zoomLevel, khong de SplashScr ghi de state khi dang download, dat guard chong trung lap CMD -74 va timeout an toan cuu ho moi trang thai loadScreen

symptom: Client Unity treo vo tan o man hinh loading/tai du lieu, ke ca sau khi xoa data va tai lai; server khong nhan duoc goi -74 getResource(1)
root_cause: NroPacketDecoder co special-case handshake -27 chi doc 1 byte, trong khi client gui frame 3 byte [cmd=-27][sizeHi=0][sizeLo=0]; 2 byte 0x00 con lai lam lech ranh gioi frame nen moi goi -74 ma hoa sau do bi giai ma sai va bi drop
rule: Khong bao gio doc rieng 1 byte cho cmd -27: handshake cua client la frame 3 byte chuan (cmd + 2 byte size). Decoder phai di qua nhanh phan khung 3 byte thong thuong; them regression test tools/test/TestHandshakeFraming.java de khoa bat bien nay

symptom: Vào lại game hoặc sau khi tải res bị xoay tròn shuriken mãi và server liên tục Added session rồi Removed session
root_cause: ServerListScreen.update() bị kẹt vòng lặp isAutoConect do testConnect không được set = 2 khi Session Key đã nhận xong, đồng thời startWaitDlg(PLEASEWAIT) ghi đè che toàn bộ nút Menu. Trong SplashScr cờ isFinished chặn chuyển cảnh sang ServerListScreen
rule: Khi Session_ME nhận key hoặc isConnected, bắt buộc cập nhật testConnect=2, tắt isAutoConect=false và đóng dialog wait; SplashScr phải dứt khoát chuyển sang ServerListScreen.switchToMe() mà không để cờ isFinished bẫy kẹt màn hình

symptom: Vao lai game hoac sau khi tai res bi xoay tron shuriken mai, Server Added/Removed session moi 16s
root_cause: GameCanvas timeout 15s dong socket do sot co loading; CMD -74 khong auto-login khi da co RMS acc; doLogin bi chan do form rong khi chua goi setUserPass
rule: Bat buoc don co loading Char.isLoadingMap va GameCanvas.endDlg() khi nhan Res match hoac tai xong res; auto-login thang neu da co RMS acc; tu dong doc RMS neu form rong trong doLogin; khong dong socket khi o ServerListScreen

symptom: Vao game bi xoay tron o WaitDlg, xoa du lieu tai lai cung bi xoay tron mai
root_cause: NettySession nuot packet -27 khong gui sendVersionRes khien Client khong nhan duoc vsRes; Session_ME gui packet plaintext khi chua co session key khien Server decoder disconnect
rule: Packet -27 phai duoc dispatch dong bo ca sendKey va sendVersionRes; Client bat buoc phai cho getKeyComplete true moi duoc gui packet tu sendKeyList

symptom: Duplicate CMD-74 type 0 sent; Client hangs 15s after Res match; clear data fails to reset ResVersion
root_cause: MyKeyHandler already sent CMD-74; Rms.clearAll missed fallback folders; isGetData left true on skip download; IOException caught swallowed on Server
rule: Route sendVersionRes solely via MyKeyHandler; purge all fallback RMS folders on clearAll; reset isGetData=false on res match; log [NET-3-DISCONNECT] on all close/exception paths

symptom: Client Unity treo 15s roi tu ngat ket noi (tDownloadTimeout) sau Res match va duplicate connect
root_cause: isGetData=true khong gui getResource(1,null); Rms fallback tim nham file ResVersion cua ban mod khac; GameCanvas.connect goi trung lap khi dang connecting; RAM GameScr vcData chua reset
rule: Gui getResource ngay khi isGetData; Cam fallback ResVersion/vsRes sang folder mod khac; Guard GameCanvas.connect voi isConnected hoac connecting; Reset RAM GameScr versions o Action 15

symptom: Console Client do ruc loi NullReferenceException tai Controller.cs:3042 moi giay
root_cause: Mob.java Server goi sendMobMaxHp gui Message(87) sai opcode thay vi -84 (MOB_MAX_HP); Client nhay vao case 87 isWind truy cap GameScr.vMob khong null-check
rule: Mob.java sendMobMaxHp dung Cmd_message.MOB_MAX_HP (-84); Controller.cs case 81-87 bat buoc bounds va null check
